data.value: The two founders of the Tidepool app have been at odds over strategy since spring. Will they announce a buyout of one side to their twelve employees within the next three months?

Tidepool is a mobile app company with twelve employees. The two founders have been in strategic disagreement since spring 2026. A buyout would involve one founder purchasing the other's shares and the departing founder leaving the company. The employees are aware of the tension but not of any specific buyout plans.
